name: butler-alfred-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions backend for B.U.T.L.E.R. Alfred

scripts.check:bundle: node --check lib/index.js && node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('./lib/index.js'); for (const n of ['api', 'alfredCallable', 'scheduledMorningBriefing']) if (typeof m[n] !== 'function') throw new Error('missing export ' + n); console.log('bundle import OK')"
